bridge.missing: The control bridge is not installed yet. Settings are shown in preview mode.

header.title: Magic Trackpad
header.copy: Adjust click feel, pointer behavior, Bluetooth battery, and startup behavior.

clicking.heading: Haptic Feedback
clicking.feedbackDescription: Maximum feedback is intentionally clicky and loud. Disable mode turns off haptic feedback and the force touch button completely.

battery.heading: Battery
battery.missingPercentage: Battery response did not include a percentage

startup.heading: Launch at Login
startup.description: Keep the control panel available from the Windows tray after sign-in.
startup.enabled: The app will open at login.
startup.disabled: The app will not open at login.

pointerStop.heading: Stop Pointer Options
pointerStop.pressurePrefix: Stop if pressure is less than or equal to
pointerStop.sizePrefix: Stop if touch area size is less than or equal to

filters.heading: Input Filtering
filters.ignoreNearFingersDescription: Ignore input from fingers not touching the trackpad surface.
filters.ignoreButtonFingerDescription: Useful when your thumb clicks while another finger moves the pointer.
filters.palmRejectionDescription: Reduce accidental input while resting your hand near the surface.

status.readyDetail: Changes apply through the bridge when available.
status.loadingDetail: Reading current settings from the bridge.
status.previewDetail: Using safe defaults until the bridge is available.
status.appliedDetail: Settings were accepted by the bridge.
status.applyRejected: The bridge did not accept the settings.
status.bridgeMissingSettingsOpened: The bridge is not installed yet, so Windows Touchpad Settings were opened directly.
